agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py's _process_identifierlist: the condition controlling when identifier-list items get individual line breaks was inverted/misplaced (wrapping only applied within VALUES, and the real SELECT-column wrap logic was hidden behind an unmet wrap_after>0 guard). Restored the correct condition (`not within Function and not within Values`) so default reindent again puts each SELECT column on its own line, while Function/Values lists just get comma-spacing (VALUES wrapping remains handled by _process_values). Verified manually against multiple reindent option combinations (default, wrap_after, comma_first, indent_columns, VALUES, function calls) producing expected output.
